text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As this year slowly transitions
from winter into spring—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—Duramente's run in the Kyodo News Hai
was still unpolished, but I saw immense potential.
Just watch, she's gonna take the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"I'm hands down with Satono Crown.
If she wins the upcoming Yayoi Sho, the Classic races are practically in the bag!"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Being an elite really makes you
keep an eye on her—Duramente, that is.
I really hope she wins the Satsuki Sho...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
I think whoever won the Kyodo News Hai
will take the Satsuki Sho too~.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —HAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...I still have too many issues around the corners...
...One more time."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
—Looks like Duramente isn't letting the
Kyodo News Hai weigh her down.
In fact, she's grown even more powerful...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown can't afford to let her guard down now.
Things just got interesting...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Born into an elite family of athletes,
the Umamusume who has recently been making a name for herself:
Duramente.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: An Umamusume of the Satono family, Satono Crown is currently regarded as the frontrunner for the Classic races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can feel the spotlight on those two
growing particularly intense lately.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As the spring GⅠ season drew near, the year's Classic-class began drawing widespread attention, just like every other year—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The interest in this generation, centered on these two, seemed to carry an unmistakably greater fervor compared to Sounds of Earth's generation last year.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Molto bene!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oops, my apologies.
I startled you, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "I was just swept up in awe all over again by her—by Miss Duramente's talent, you see."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah! There's a very good chance we'll have a session
with them sometime this year, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I just want to know more about you.
Both how you run, and who you are as a performer.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
If I were to jam with those girls who are drawing
so much attention even now, what kind of music would it make—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Benissimo...!!
Just picturing it makes my heart dance...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sounds of Earth takes the spotlight on the younger generation positively, true to her nature. It seems there's no need to worry on that front.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...Direttore.
From here on, there's something I'd like to consult you about—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...Direttrice.
From here on, there's something I'd like to consult you about—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Alongside our training,
would you mind if I harmonized with them for just a bit?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
After all, the best way to understand each individual's melody
is to actually listen to it firsthand.
choice_data_list: Of course, I don't mind at all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Time and time again, it has been proven that interacting with other Umamusume gives Sounds of Earth strength.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it was also true that what Sounds of Earth sought
lay beyond generational boundaries.
There was no reason whatsoever to stop him.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Grazie! I promise you,
I will deliver magnificent music to you in the future!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hup...! Hup...!!
——Alright, and that's a wrap...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! 
Now then, what's next on the menu—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Buongiorno, Satono Crown.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Earth-san!
Good work today.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I was caught up in the heat
of your passionate training...!
Mind if I join in?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind at all!
Shall we work up a sweat together?"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Hup...! Hup...!
I see... Rather than the Satsuki Sho—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Winning a GⅠ in and of itself...
Your passion is fiercely dedicated to that goal, isn't it...!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! It is... the Satono family's
long-cherished dream, after all...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Right now, I'm the one...! Closest... to "that place"...!! *Phew*—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
A sound that is supple, yet possesses a firm, solid core—
Yes. It's so like you, truly wonderful...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ah, could that be...
the rumored 'talking about races through music' thing?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì! I've long wished to harmonize
our melodies together someday...!
And that is why I find myself listening so closely now.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
In that case, please look forward to it.
I'll deliver some wonderful music to you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Let us hear the sublime melody
of Satono Crown, the Umamusume who fulfilled her cherished wish!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—*Molto bene*!!
You're really getting the crowd fired up, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—...Alright.
Looks like there's still time for more training.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...?
Is this... a violin...?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Such magnificent technique...—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Fiercely.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...This is a song inspired by your name.
Do you like it?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
That was a wonderful performance.
The fierce, powerful melody was amazing, too.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Grazie!!
Such straightforward praise is so like you...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Why did you have me listen to this song?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to know more about you, Duramente-san.
When faced with music, we naturally reveal who we truly are, after all.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Is that so?
...Did you figure something out?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: I've come to understand just how pure-hearted you are.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: The light in her eyes... the words she weaves... and the way she approaches music—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—And the way you run, too.
As well as your strength.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I've come to want to see it.
What kind of melody that pure, unadulterated strength hidden within you will play upon the turf!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Then watch closely.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
In the races to come, I will prove
what it means to be the "strongest."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ohh...! Magnificent...!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—I'm looking forward to it, Duramente.
That wild yet pure running of yours.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—All riiight!
Dia-chan, let's pump ourselves up for one more!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I still need to get plenty more running in!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan & Dia
text_block_list.text: —Hup!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan & Dia
text_block_list.text:
—HAAAAAAAAAHHH!!!
—YAAAAAAAAAHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Beniiissimo!!!
A harmony that elevates both of us!! Magnificent!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan & Dia
text_block_list.text:
"Whaa?! Earth-san?!
Huh?! Earth-san?!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Don't mind me!!
Go, quickly!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan & Dia
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, sir!
Y-Yes!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—*Pant, pant, pant*...!
Wh-Why are you here, Earth-san...?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(—Kitasan Black.
An Umamusume from the generation below mine, carrying a lively sound like a festival.)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry to interrupt your precious time.
But I just couldn't sit still anymore.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Because all of you—
produce such a breathtakingly beautiful harmony!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Such a lively melody born of a powerful bond...!
I just couldn't resist coming closer to listen, and well, here I am!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Umm... what's "harmonia"?
I don't really get it, but—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so happy you said that
Dia-chan and I have a strong bond!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: “Yeah. Because even now, the two of us were pushing each other to improve...!”

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (—Satono Diamond. Like Crown, she's an Umamusume of the Satono family, and she too carries the sound of an unyielding will to fulfill their cherished wish...)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: If I remember correctly, you two were childhood friends, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Kita-chan and I have been together since we were little—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Chasing our aspirations... We entered Tracen Academy
together to make our respective dreams come true."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Running in the same race with you is one of my dreams, too...
So I plan to keep giving it my all, today and always!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Nnh...! So beautiful...!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "When the paths you run intersect... I would love to hear what kind of music is born from the very front row...!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
No, if anything—
I want to perform alongside you...!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Umm, so does that mean...
you want to race with us
sometime... kind of thing?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I'm truly looking forward to it...!
To see what kind of musicians you will all blossom into!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
“—I'll keep cheering for you on my own, okay!
Sorry to bother you, see ya around!”

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...There they go.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—
Earth-san always looks like
she's having so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I know what you mean!
It's like it gives you energy too—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...*Sigh*. What am I even doing?
The pool isn't the ocean, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...This is no time to be doing this, though.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...It feels as if she's still harboring deep pain.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (Cheval Grand. An Umamusume whose gentle rhythm also carries a heroic pulse――)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (She is extraordinarily delicate. I mustn't drown out her theme by carelessly letting my own melody be heard...)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Now is not quite the time yet.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Pauses, too, are an essential part of musical composition.
...Let us wait, thoroughly and patiently.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the Nikkei Sho drawing near, Sounds of Earth
cherished the sounds of the new generation like that—
